description: When the plan carries a preferred-product hint and it is in stock, ShopperHound selects it over a cheaper generic.

input.userMessage: Shop 'yoghurt' with a preferred product hint of 'Yeo Valley Natural'.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BasketResult whose line matches the preferred product hint.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: A preferred-product hint outranks a cheaper generic when in stock, and is not a substitution.

scoring.passCriteria: Basket line is the preferred Yeo Valley Natural, not the cheaper generic.
